title: Slovakian Keto Pork Casserole
description: A hearty, keto-friendly Slovakian-inspired casserole made with ground pork, served in a rich and creamy sauce. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Cook the ground pork in a large skillet over medium-high heat, until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the cubed Slovakian bread and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked pork mixture, sour cream, and shredded cheddar cheese. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
